components.name: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
components.description: Cloud-based identity and access management service

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Block legacy authentication using Conditional Access
Enable MFA for all admin accounts via Conditional Access
Review and restrict guest user access regularly

bestPractices: Use managed identities instead of service principals where possible
Enable Conditional Access with MFA for all users
Implement least privilege with Azure AD roles
Monitor sign-in logs for suspicious activity

components.name: Virtual Network (VNet)
components.description: Isolated network environment for Azure resources

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Overly permissive NSG rules (e.g., 0.0.0.0/0 on RDP/SSH)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Restrict source IPs to known ranges, use Just-In-Time VM access
Enable Azure DDoS Protection Standard for production VNets
Use private endpoints and Azure Bastion instead of public IPs

bestPractices: Use hub-spoke network topology for enterprise deployments
Implement network segmentation with multiple subnets
Enable NSG flow logs for traffic analysis
Use Azure Private Link for PaaS services

components.name: Azure Key Vault
components.description: Centralized secrets, keys, and certificate management
securityControls: Key Vault access policies for data plane

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Firewall disabled (public network access allowed from all networks)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enable Key Vault firewall and restrict to specific VNets/IPs
Enable soft delete and purge protection

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Excessive access policies (List/Get permissions for all secrets)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Grant minimal permissions per application identity

bestPractices: Use managed identities for applications to access Key Vault
Enable diagnostic logging to Log Analytics
Rotate secrets and keys regularly
Use separate Key Vaults for different environments

components.name: Azure Storage Account
components.description: Scalable cloud storage for blobs, files, queues, and tables

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Disable public access at storage account level, use SAS tokens
Enable 'Secure transfer required' setting
Enable storage account firewall and whitelist specific IPs/VNets

bestPractices: Use private endpoints for storage accounts
Enable Advanced Threat Protection for Storage
Implement lifecycle management policies
Use customer-managed keys for encryption

components.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
components.description: Cloud security posture management and workload protection
securityControls: Vulnerability scanning for VMs and containers

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Defender plans not enabled for all resource types
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enable Defender for Servers, Storage, Databases, Containers, etc.

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Security alerts ignored or not routed
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Configure alert notifications and integrate with SIEM
Prioritize high-severity recommendations and implement fixes

bestPractices: Enable all Defender plans for comprehensive coverage
Export security data to Log Analytics workspace
Integrate with Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM capabilities
Automate remediation using Azure Policy

components.name: Microsoft Sentinel
components.description: Cloud-native SIEM and security orchestration solution
securityControls: Data connectors for Azure and third-party sources
Built-in analytics rules for threat detection

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enable connectors for all critical Azure services and data sources
Tune analytics rules to reduce false positives
Create playbooks for common incident types (e.g., user compromise)

bestPractices: Ingest logs from all critical resources
Create custom analytics rules for organization-specific threats
Use watchlists for known good/bad indicators
Implement SOAR playbooks for automated response

components.name: Azure App Service
components.description: Managed platform for hosting web apps, APIs, and mobile backends

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enable 'HTTPS Only' setting and redirect HTTP to HTTPS
Enable App Service Authentication with Entra ID
Set minimum TLS version to 1.2 or 1.3
Disable remote debugging for production slots

bestPractices: Use deployment slots for staging and blue-green deployments
Enable diagnostic logging to Application Insights
Use managed identities to access other Azure resources
Implement custom domains with TLS certificates from Key Vault

components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
securityControls: Azure Key Vault integration via CSI driver

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enable private cluster or restrict authorized IP ranges

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Default service account with cluster-admin permissions
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Implement least-privilege RBAC, disable default service account auto-mount
Enable network policy addon and create deny-all default policy

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Secrets stored as Kubernetes Secrets (base64 encoded)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Use Azure Key Vault CSI driver for secrets management

bestPractices: Enable Azure AD RBAC for cluster access control
Use pod-managed identities (AAD Pod Identity or Workload Identity)
Implement admission controllers (OPA Gatekeeper or Azure Policy)
Enable AKS-managed Azure AD integration
Use Azure Container Registry with private endpoints

components.name: Azure SQL Database

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Remove 'Allow Azure services' rule, use private endpoints

commonMisconfigurations.issue: SQL authentication enabled with weak passwords
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Enforce Azure AD authentication only, disable SQL logins
Enable auditing to Log Analytics workspace
Use customer-managed keys from Key Vault for TDE

bestPractices: Use private endpoints for all database connections
Enable Advanced Data Security with vulnerability assessments
Implement row-level security and dynamic data masking
Use managed identities for application database access

components.name: Azure Application Gateway / WAF
components.description: Layer 7 load balancer with Web Application Firewall

commonMisconfigurations.issue: WAF in detection mode only (not prevention)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Switch WAF to prevention mode after tuning rules
Enable SSL offload at gateway and re-encrypt to backend

commonMisconfigurations.issue: No custom WAF rules for application-specific threats
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Create custom rules for known attack patterns

bestPractices: Use Application Gateway v2 SKU for better performance
Configure health probes for backend pool members
Enable request/response logging to Log Analytics
Integrate with Azure Front Door for global load balancing

components.name: Azure Front Door
components.description: Global load balancer and CDN with WAF capabilities

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Use Private Link or restrict backend NSGs to Front Door service tags
Implement geo-filtering to block high-risk countries
Disable caching for authenticated endpoints and sensitive routes

bestPractices: Use Front Door Premium for Private Link support
Enable health probes and session affinity
Configure custom WAF rules for application protection
Use managed TLS certificates for custom domains

components.name: Azure Policy
components.description: Policy enforcement and compliance management service
securityControls: Built-in regulatory compliance policies (CIS, PCI-DSS, NIST)
Policy assignments at management group or subscription level

commonMisconfigurations.issue: No policies assigned at subscription level
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Assign Azure Security Benchmark initiative at minimum

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Policies set to audit only (not deny/remediate)
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Use deny effect for critical policies, remediate existing violations
Minimize policy exclusions and document justifications

bestPractices: Start with Azure Security Benchmark initiative
Create custom policies for organization-specific requirements
Use management groups for hierarchical policy assignment
Enable automatic remediation tasks for compliant deployments

components.name: Azure Bastion
components.description: Fully managed RDP/SSH gateway without public IPs
securityControls: No public IP required on VMs
Integration with Azure AD for authentication

commonMisconfigurations.issue: VMs still have public IPs alongside Bastion
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Remove all public IPs from VMs after deploying Bastion

commonMisconfigurations.issue: NSG rules allow direct RDP/SSH from internet
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Remove all NSG rules allowing inbound 22/3389 from internet

bestPractices: Deploy Bastion in a dedicated subnet (AzureBastionSubnet)
Use Bastion Standard SKU for native client support
Enable session recording for compliance
Combine with JIT access for additional security

components.name: Azure Monitor / Log Analytics

commonMisconfigurations.issue: Diagnostic settings not enabled on all resources
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Use Azure Policy to enforce diagnostic settings on all resource types
Set retention to 90+ days for security logs, use archive for compliance

commonMisconfigurations.issue: No alerting configured for critical events
commonMisconfigurations.fix: Create alert rules for security events (failed logins, policy violations)

bestPractices: Create dedicated Log Analytics workspace per environment
Use Azure Policy to automatically configure diagnostic settings
Export logs to Storage Account for long-term retention
Create custom workbooks for security monitoring

components.name: Azure Firewall
components.description: Fully managed, stateful firewall with high availability

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Ensure implicit deny is active, explicitly allow only required traffic
Enable Threat Intelligence in Alert and Deny mode
Enable diagnostic settings to send firewall logs to workspace

bestPractices: Use Azure Firewall Premium for TLS inspection and IDPS
Deploy in hub VNet for centralized traffic filtering
Use Azure Firewall Manager for multi-firewall deployments
Create FQDN-based application rules instead of IP-based

components.name: Azure Container Registry
components.description: Private Docker registry for container images

commonMisconfigurations.fix: Disable admin account, use Azure AD authentication and managed identities
Disable public access, use private endpoints
Enable Microsoft Defender for Containers to scan images

bestPractices: Use Premium SKU for private endpoints and geo-replication
Enable content trust and sign all images
Implement least-privilege RBAC roles (AcrPull, AcrPush)
Use quarantine pattern to prevent vulnerable images from deployment

architecturePatterns.name: Zero Trust Network Architecture
architecturePatterns.description: Never trust, always verify approach to network security
implementation: Implement Conditional Access with device compliance checks
Use Private Endpoints for all PaaS services
Enable Just-In-Time VM access
Verify explicitly with MFA for all admin operations

architecturePatterns.name: Defense in Depth
architecturePatterns.description: Layered security controls across all tiers
implementation: Identity layer: MFA + Conditional Access
Network layer: NSGs + Azure Firewall + DDoS Protection
Application layer: WAF + Managed identities
Data layer: Encryption at rest + TLS in transit
Monitoring layer: Sentinel + Defender for Cloud

architecturePatterns.name: Hub-Spoke Network Topology
architecturePatterns.description: Centralized network architecture for multi-subscription environments
implementation: Deploy Azure Firewall and Bastion in hub VNet
Connect spoke VNets via VNet peering
Route all internet traffic through hub firewall
Centralize DNS resolution in hub
Deploy shared services (monitoring, security) in hub

architecturePatterns.name: Landing Zone Architecture
implementation: Use management groups for hierarchical governance
Deploy Azure Policy at management group level
Implement centralized logging to Log Analytics
Separate subscriptions by workload and environment
Use Azure Blueprints for repeatable deployments

architecturePatterns.name: Secure DevOps Pipeline
architecturePatterns.description: Security-integrated CI/CD pipeline with shift-left approach
implementation: Scan container images in CI with Trivy/Defender
Use managed identities for pipeline authentication
Store secrets in Key Vault, reference in pipeline
Implement pull request gates with security checks
Deploy using infrastructure as code with policy validation

architecturePatterns.name: Microservices Security
implementation: Deploy AKS with private cluster and Azure CNI
Use service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) for mTLS between services
Implement API Gateway (APIM or App Gateway) as entry point
Use Workload Identity for pod-to-Azure authentication
Enable Azure Policy for Kubernetes admission control

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure Resource Graph to query all resources, tag resources consistently

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
cisControls.implementation: Classify data using Azure Information Protection, implement retention policies

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure Policy for configuration baselines, implement Azure Blueprints

cisControls.title: Establish an Access Granting Process
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure AD Conditional Access, implement PIM for privileged roles

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain Audit Log Management
cisControls.implementation: Enable diagnostic settings for all resources, centralize logs in Log Analytics

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure AD reporting to inventory all user and service principal accounts

cisControls.title: Use Unique Passwords
cisControls.implementation: Enable Azure AD Password Protection, enforce password policies via Conditional Access

cisControls.title: Establish an Access Revoking Process
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure AD access reviews to periodically review and revoke excessive permissions

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
cisControls.implementation: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud vulnerability assessments for VMs and containers

cisControls.title: Ensure Network Infrastructure is Up-to-Date
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure Firewall with auto-update for threat intelligence, keep NSG rules current

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure Bastion or Privileged Access Workstations (PAW) for admin tasks

cisControls.title: Centralize Security Event Alerting
cisControls.implementation: Route all security alerts to Microsoft Sentinel, configure alert rules and action groups

cisControls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
cisControls.implementation: Enable NSG Flow Logs and send to Log Analytics for traffic analysis

cisControls.title: Establish and Maintain a Security Awareness Program
cisControls.implementation: Use Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps to detect and alert on risky user behavior

cisControls.title: Remediate Penetration Test Findings
cisControls.implementation: Use Azure Security Benchmark recommendations from Defender for Cloud as remediation guide
